subject: maths
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Read and write large numbers up to crores in the Indian system
Compare the Indian and international systems, and read and write numbers in the international system
Write numbers in expanded form and back, and compare large numbers by place value
Form the greatest and smallest numbers from given digits
Round numbers to the nearest 10, 100 and 1000
Represent numbers with Roman symbols
Use place value beyond 1000 in the four operations
Use the standard methods for adding, subtracting and multiplying large numbers
Divide a number by a number of up to two digits, by the standard method and by splitting the number
Estimate sums, differences, products and quotients, and check them
Solve real-life problems with the four operations, and write word problems for given statements
Explain what factors and multiples mean, and find some of each
Tell proper, improper and mixed fractions apart
Write equivalent fractions and find the fractional part of a collection
Compare and order three or more fractions
Add and subtract unlike fractions and mixed numbers
Multiply and divide fractions, understanding 'of' as multiplication
Read decimal fractions with denominators 10, 100 and 1000, and their place value
Compare, order, add and subtract decimal fractions
Multiply decimals by 10, 100 and 1000, and by other decimals
Find multiples and factors of numbers, using factor trees and skip counting
Tell prime, composite, twin prime and co-prime numbers apart
Find prime and composite numbers up to 100
Test divisibility by 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 11 by spotting rules
Find HCF and LCM by listing and by common division
See how HCF and LCM are related, and use one to find the other
Show whole numbers and integers on a number line
Understand integers as counting numbers, zero and negatives of counting numbers
Use negative numbers for temperature below zero, sea level and profit and loss
Compare and order integers on a number line
Add and subtract integers
Explore angles, and classify them as right, acute or obtuse by drawing and tracing
Find right angles and other angles in the classroom and environment
Recognise reflection and rotational symmetry in 2D shapes and letters
Find symmetry in familiar 3D shapes such as a cube
Make cubes, cuboids, cylinders and cones from given nets, and trace nets from boxes
Learn the words plane, point, line, line segment, ray, parallel, intersecting and perpendicular
Draw plan, elevation and side views of 3D objects
Convert between larger and smaller units of length, weight, time and money
Estimate the volume of a solid in known units, such as a bucket being about 20 mugs
Solve problems on money, length, weight, capacity and time with the four operations
Explain area and perimeter, and see that the two are not linked
Find the area and perimeter of simple shapes, using squared grids
Understand percent as a fraction out of 100
Link fractions, decimals and percentages
Show percentages in pictures
Convert fractions and decimals to percentages, and back
Solve simple word problems on percentages, such as marks in a test
Collect data from daily life and show it in a table and a bar graph
Interpret a given bar graph
Read and interpret pie charts and line graphs from newspapers and magazines
Present a group project with tables and graphs
Observe and extend patterns with a unit of repeat
Extend a progressive pattern by finding its rule
Create a pattern with more than one feature
Find triangular and square numbers, and their rules
Find later terms of a number pattern from its rule, without listing the earlier terms

gaps: Teaching processes and learning resources are left out; the file lists only what a child learns.
Some decimal examples in the text extract are garbled; the file uses the written outcomes only.
